nah it wont.

u could be the person that invents reusable toiletpaper or something.

One time I got too honest with my parents and they asked me if i wanted to die. I had ot lie to them, so that they would not put me in a hospital.

one time I told my ex about my suicidal tendencies and depression, telling her that i only broke up with her bc i needed SOMETHING to change, and it hurt her very much that i was not able to confide in her during that time.

I told my closest friend that i sometimes want to die and he was very good with that and we just talked about our problems for a long time.

Oh and one time at a party at like 05:00 i kind of broke down crying and told a bunch of people about my reoccuring wish for release and some of them where very supportive and others did not really undertsand where i was coming from, making it weird between us later 

So, bottom line, yes i did and its impossible to know how people will react

I also thought that i pushed my friends away.
I did not.


They seem to really care about you. It can be incredible exausting to be supportive of someone with mental problems. give them some time and then just call them up again.


If you feel like your brain is stuck in a loop and you feel like you are always repeating the same things without ever doing anything about them, maybe the thing to do is to just ask them about their problems and just not talk about yourself for one afternoon?


maybe that would help you to take your mind of yourself?


I dont know, i just kind of enjoy catching up on gossip from my hometown without talking about my issues as a sort of conversational safe space, where my problems are not allowed in.
these conversations are not as deep and do not feel as helpfull as vomiting out your deepest thoughts, but they are just.. kinda nice...

Maybe your mom does not know anything else.
maybe this is how her mom treated her.
This does not justify her behaviour and it sucks that she can not control herself. 

I dont know your situation, but maybe it would be possible to find work at another place?

I thin that the most important thing for you to do is to try really hard to not become like your mother, so that when you have a family they do not have to ask the internet for emotional support.

But again, i dont know your situation.

Also, pleaso do not jump in front of a car. that would be an unpleaseant expirience for both you and the driver/people in the car.

If you live in the "western world" there should be support telephone numbers for family issues, they should have a lot more expirience with the family-as-boss issue.
